apps.localizedDescription:
**TwitchMods v0.1.16**, for Twitch iOS **31.7**

### New: clear up the stream screen
Settings has a new **Declutter** section with all the "hide" options in one place. New ones, all off by default:
- **Hide Channel Bar**: removes the bar under the video and gives that space to chat. Tap the video to see the channel info, Follow and the other buttons.
- **Hide Leaderboard**: removes the top gifters and cheerers strip.
- **Hide Subscribe Buttons**: removes Subscribe and Gift a Sub.
- **Hide Bits Button**: removes the cheering button from the chat box.
- **Hide Extensions Button**: removes the button for extensions like viewer maps.
- **Hide "+" (Create) Button**: removes the Create button from the bottom tab bar.

Go Ad-Free, Stories, "From Channels You Follow" and the 7TV bar options have moved here too. Your existing choices carry over.

### New: wide emotes keep their shape
Wide 7TV, BetterTTV and FrankerFaceZ emotes aren't squished anymore. They're a bit smaller, but not distorted, and animated ones still move. Prefer the old look? Turn off **Keep Wide Emote Shape** in Settings → Emotes. Emotes should also show up faster in busy chats.

### Fixed
- With an ad-block proxy on, the first channel on the Live page could get stuck loading and never play.
- With **Hide "Go Ad-Free" Button** on, Twitch could crash when switching tabs, and Stream Manager and Analytics could go missing from your profile page.
- With **Hide "From Channels You Follow"** on, the Live page only showed the first channel until you scrolled.

### Downloads
- **`tv.twitch-31.7-TwitchAdBlock-0.1.16.ipa`**: the full app.
- **`tv.twitch-31.7-TwitchAdBlock-0.1.16-noplugins.ipa`**: app extensions removed, so a free Apple ID only uses 1 App ID slot when sideloading.

Using the AltStore / SideStore / Feather source? You'll get this update automatically:
```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gunnerkidBT/TwitchAdBlock/master/apps.json
```

Full plain-language changelog: [`CHANGELOG.md`](https://github.com/gunnerkidBT/TwitchAdBlock/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md)
